name: @atqan/qaraa-server
description: Qur’an recitation alignment library for real-time word tracking, phoneme-aware matching, confidence-gated error detection, and stable reading progress.

scripts.build: tsdown --no-config src/index.ts --format esm --format cjs --dts --out-dir dist --sourcemap --clean --logLevel error --deps.never-bundle fastify --deps.never-bundle @fastify/websocket --deps.never-bundle @atqan/qaraa-core --deps.never-bundle @atqan/qaraa-protocol && node ../../scripts/write-esm-wrapper.mjs dist/index.cjs dist/index.mjs && node ../../scripts/remove-dts-sourcemap.mjs dist/index.d.mts dist/index.d.cts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && pnpm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.consumer.json
